```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(nngeo)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```

# Coral reef results

```{r}
reef_nutri<-st_read(here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Nitrogen_on_reefs.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., t_crs)
```



```{r}
sub_reef_nutri<-reef_nutri %>% 
   filter(n_reefs>0) %>% 
   mutate(n_reefs_tonnes = n_reefs*0.001)

sub_reef_nutri<- sub_reef_nutri %>% 
   arrange(desc(n_reefs_tonnes)) %>% 
   mutate(cumsum_n = cumsum(n_reefs_tonnes),
          prop = cumsum_n/sum(sub_reef_nutri$n_reefs_tonnes, na.rm = T))
 
 top_90<-sub_reef_nutri %>% 
   filter(prop <=0.9)
 
 nrow(top_90)
 
 reef_nutri_df<-sub_reef_nutri %>% 
   as.data.frame() %>% 
   dplyr::select(-geometry)
```

```{r}
sum(reef_nutri_df$n_reefs_tonnes,na.rm = T)
sum(reef_nutri_df$n_reefs_tonnes,na.rm = T)/385.9
```

```{r}
nrow(sub_reef_nutri)/nrow(reef_nutri)
```

```{r}
nrow(top_90)/nrow(sub_reef_nutri)
```

# Fiji Tikinas

```{r}
tik<-st_read(here("projected_data/Tikina/Fiji_tikina.shp")) %>% 
   st_transform(., t_crs)

tik_df<-tik %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(TIKINA, ADM1_NAME)
```



# Nearest Tikina to each coral reef

```{r}
test<-sub_reef_nutri %>% 
  mutate(area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.)))

cent<-st_centroid(test)

st_write(cent,here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Reef_nutrient_centroids.shp"), delete_layer = TRUE)

reef_tik_dist<-st_nn(cent, tik, k = 1, parallel = 10, returnDist = T) %>% 
   unlist() %>% 
   as.data.frame()

reef_tik_dist2<-reef_tik_dist %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "Type")

pos<-reef_tik_dist2 %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Type, "nn")) %>% 
   rename(tik_val = ".")

test2<-tik_df[pos$tik_val,] %>% 
   as.data.frame() 

dist<-reef_tik_dist2 %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Type, "dist")) %>% 
   rename(distance = ".") %>% 
   dplyr::select(distance)

done<-cbind(cent, test2) %>% 
   cbind(., dist)

nutri_by_tikina <- done %>% 
   as.data.frame() %>% 
   dplyr::select(-geometry) %>% 
   group_by(TIKINA) %>% 
   summarise(total_n = sum(n_reefs_tonnes, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  full_join(., tik, by = c("TIKINA"))

st_write(done, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Reef_nutrients_nearest_Tikina.shp"), delete_layer = T)
st_write(nutri_by_tikina, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Tikina_reef_nutrients.shp"), delete_layer = T)
```


# Nearest Main basin to each coral reef

```{r}
basin<-st_read(here("projected_data/Basins/Fiji_basins12.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., t_crs) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
  summarise(total_area = sum(area_m2, na.rm = T))

basin_df<-basin %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::select(-geometry) %>% 
  dplyr::select(MAIN_BAS)
```


```{r}

reef_bas_dist<-st_nn(cent, basin, k = 1, parallel = 10, returnDist = T) %>% 
   unlist() %>% 
   as.data.frame()

reef_bas_dist2<-reef_bas_dist %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(., "Type")

bas_pos<-reef_bas_dist2 %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Type, "nn")) %>% 
   rename(bas_val = ".")

bas_test2<-basin_df[bas_pos$bas_val,] %>% 
   as.data.frame()  %>% 
  rename(MAIN_BAS = ".")

bas_dist<-reef_bas_dist2 %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Type, "dist")) %>% 
   rename(distance = ".") %>% 
   dplyr::select(distance)

bas_done<-cbind(cent, bas_test2) %>% 
   cbind(., bas_dist)

nutri_by_basin <- bas_done %>% 
   as.data.frame() %>% 
   dplyr::select(-geometry) %>% 
   group_by(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
   summarise(total_n = sum(n_reefs_tonnes, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  full_join(., basin)

st_write(bas_done, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Reef_nutrients_nearest_basin.shp"), delete_layer = T)
st_write(nutri_by_basin, here("output_data/Nutrients_at_reefs/Basin_reef_nutrients.shp"), delete_layer = T)
```
